gen-gf-asimovian-fs-erode: Asimovian has big, washer-round lowercase eyes and strokes that never vary in width, a tubular look that feels thoroughly modern. And Erode, a text serif with gentle swells in its weight, carries a longer passage along with a dignified, editorial ease.
gen-gf-asimovian-fs-karma: Trustworthy is the first word that comes to mind for Karma, though Asimovian's tube-like, constant-width strokes lead the pair with a modern edge. But the text serif's quiet contrast and tidy terminals hold everything together, which is the quality you remember.
gen-gf-athiti-fs-erode: Wire-fine and wide open, Athiti leads with curves that end in plain daylight. Erode follows in its classic serif dress, its sturdy bowls and lightly thinned links giving the thin, even headings a grounded, editorial partner underneath.
gen-gf-athiti-fs-karma: Athiti's oversized counters and wire-like curves, which hold their weight right through the shoulders, set the tone at the top. But Karma does the quieter work, with a faint nib-pressure variation in its rounds that makes the serif feel settled and trustworthy.
gen-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-fs-erode: Modern in a no-fuss way, Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps its curves smooth and its hairline thinning low. Erode, a serif with a tall middle band and modest thinning, adds a dignified, editorial voice below.
gen-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-fs-karma: Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps a short stretch from midline to ascender, so its bends run smooth and unobstructed. And Karma, a text serif, does the opposite job, its soft accents of heavier strokes giving a long read a steady, classic rhythm.
gen-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono-fs-ero: Erode reads as a dignified, editorial voice, its tall middle band and broad apertures keeping each line open. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, with its funnel-wide e and generous x-height, gives the top a friendlier, more contemporary footing than any classic serif usually gets.
gen-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono-fs-kar: Friendly, wide-throated mono letters up top, with an oversized x-height. Karma then brings a middling thick-thin difference and a trustworthy, classic calm, and that steadiness is what holds the pairing together.
gen-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-next-fs-ero: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next spreads its curve ends wide and lifts its x-height close to the cap height, which feels modern and businesslike. Erode's classic serif strokes then keep a long page moving gently.
gen-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-next-fs-kar: Karma is a classic serif with terminals that finish clear of the stem and almost no gap between x-height and cap height. Karma's quiet modulation never snags the eye, and that unfussy trustworthiness is the strongest thing about the pair.
